AGENCY QUESTIONS

Resolve the risk
before the brief arrives.

Commercial and confidentiality terms are recorded in the actual proposal.

Who is the pilot designed for?+

Small design, branding, SEO and marketing agencies with approved website work and no need for another permanent developer.

Will SiteSutra contact our client?+

No direct client contact happens without your written approval. Your agency owns the relationship, communication and commercial terms.

Can we sign an NDA first?+

Yes. Review and sign suitable confidentiality terms before you share protected client material or repository access.

What does the ₹35,000 starting price assume?+

It assumes one approved landing page, supplied final copy and assets, one existing form or booking destination, one consolidated revision round and a defined source handover. Added scope receives a written price and timing change before work begins.

How does payment work?+

The proposed starting arrangement is 50 percent to schedule the pilot and 50 percent after staging approval, before final source handover. The signed proposal records the exact milestones and applicable tax.

What technology can you work with?+

This website demonstrates HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a Git based review workflow. Share your stack, repository and deployment requirements for a capability check before the proposal.

What if our inputs are not ready?+

The delivery window starts only after the approved design, copy, assets, access and named approver are ready. SiteSutra will flag missing inputs before scheduling the build.

Can the pilot grow into ongoing work?+

Yes, after both sides review the pilot. A larger project or monthly capacity arrangement receives a separate scope, availability check and commercial proposal.
